issue.title: groupby with observed=False raises KeyError on categorical column
issue.body:
### Reproducible Example
```python
import pandas as pd
df = pd.DataFrame({'a': pd.Categorical(['x', 'y']), 'b': [1, 2]})
df.groupby('a', observed=False)['c'].sum()
```
### Issue Description
KeyError: 'c' is raised, expected a clearer message.
